email.subject: Iron Tide Pros: two quick fixes
email.body:
Tom,

I checked the Iron Tide Pros site. Your homepage title tag is weak (generic, no mention of Harbor Falls or fitness), so you're likely losing ground to competitors in local Google search results, that's usually the single biggest traffic leak on small business sites. Your footer also has outdated info (old hours/contact), which can make visitors double back to Google to verify you're still open before calling.

Both are quick fixes. I run Northlight Web, flat-fee website fixes for local businesses. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change and why.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
